title: Deliciu Mate Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Ice Prefilled Vape Pods - 20mg
description: Keep your Vaporesso Deliciu Mate vaping experience fresh and flavourful with the Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Ice Prefilled Pods. Designed for convenience and ease of use, this pack includes two 2ml prefilled pods filled with 20mg nic salt e-liquid. Together, they offer a seamless vaping experience with a delightful blend of strawberry, raspberry, and cherry flavours enhanced by a cool menthol finish. The Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Ice flavour provides a balanced and refreshing vaping experience, perfect for those who enjoy a mix of sweet fruits with a menthol twist. Each pod is equipped with Vaporesso's advanced COREX 2.0 mesh coil technology, ensuring dense, flavourful vapour from the first puff to the last. These prefilled pods are exclusively compatible with the Vaporesso Deliciu Mate device, making it easy to switch flavours without the hassle of refilling. Simply replace your used pod with a new one and continue enjoying your vape.
